audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer level chart and the content-layer win[] array disagree on every single row (phases say Lux/Lux/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill/Skill, win[] says Skill/Skill/Lux/Lux/Lux/Lux/Lux).
audit.why: The packet's levelChart matches win[] exactly (Skill, Skill, then Lux from level 3 on), and the content whys already describe that exact story (even early because Light Binding is long-cooldown, Lux pulling ahead from level 3 via E poke and the root-combo, snowballing through Final Spark and Ludens/Torch). The full-layer phases.side/why were never aligned to it.
audit.corrected: Flip phases[0-1].side to Skill and phases[2-6].side to Lux, rewriting each .why to match the already-correct content narrative.

audit.why: Spikes array already correctly identifies level 6 (Final Spark execute burst) and first item (Ludens/Torch one-shot combo) as Lux's power spikes; these are grounded in her kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Light Binding as 'matchup-defining' but gives no actual cooldown number, and never states Soraka's own E cooldown either — both are lint-flagged as missing digits.
audit.why: Light Binding is a flat 10s cooldown per the kit (not a per-rank scale), and Soraka's E (Equinox) is 20/19/18/17/16s. Concrete numbers let the reader count down the window instead of relying on vague 'matchup-defining' language.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns to state both numbers explicitly.
